title: Instruments Joe Clancy played
summary: Joe Clancy played bass, trombone and drums as far as Sherwood knows.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: And about Joe Clancy, how many instruments did he play?
That I know of, bass, trombone and drums. Now if there were any others I don't know. I know he had those instruments and I saw him play them.
